name: conditional_node_routes_on_previous_outcome_via_context
workflow:
digraph T {
  start [shape=Mdiamond]
  exit [shape=Msquare]

  work [prompt="x"]
  gate [shape=diamond]
  fix [prompt="x"]
  start -> work -> gate
  gate -> exit [condition="context.verified=true"]
  gate -> fix
  fix -> exit

}
